prose.favour: The case in its favour rests mostly on growth: profit grew 9% compared with a year earlier. Other areas on this side: the balance sheet, risk, cash flow and the balance sheet.
prose.against: The case against rests mostly on the recent price trend: the share price is 14.8% lower than a year ago. Also against it: over the past year the share did 13.1 percentage points worse than the Nifty 50; the share price is 25% below its 52-week high; and value scores only 24 of 100 against the comparison pool. Other areas on this side: what the price asks for the earnings, what the price implies, cash flow and the balance sheet.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 6 points in favour and 7 against give more points against. The pool score is 47 of 100. The side that carries most weight is the recent price trend. That gives an educational rating of Hold with high confidence. This is a rule-based reading of the evidence above, not a prediction.
